preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10.
Number of people living in Hanh's apartment is between 2 and 1000.
Number of steel chains required is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= a_i <= 10^4 for all i in range(1, n+1)
preconditions.description: Weight of each fridge is between 0 and 10^4.

postconditions.description: Output -1 if there is no solution, otherwise proceed to output the minimum total cost and the chains.
If there is no solution, the output should be exactly '-1'.
If there is a solution, the output should start with the minimum total cost.
If there is a solution, the number of lines after the cost should be exactly m.

postconditions.expression: if not no_solution: all(u != v for u, v in chains)
postconditions.description: Each chain should connect two different fridges.

postconditions.expression: if not no_solution: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in chains)
postconditions.description: Each fridge index in the chains should be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: if not no_solution: sum(a[u-1] + a[v-1] for u, v in chains) == min_cost
postconditions.description: The total cost of the chains should be equal to the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: if not no_solution: all(len([chain for chain in chains if chain[0] == i or chain[1] == i]) == 1 for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each fridge should be connected by exactly one chain to ensure privacy.
